title: CapabilitySnapshot - the acquisition conditions a record was produced under
description: MRBS DQ-003 requires every signal to carry a CapabilitySnapshotId; DQ-004 requires historical and live to publish capability separately. This is the object that id resolves to. Every surface entry must cite at least one EvidenceId, so a capability claim is checkable rather than asserted.

acquisitionPath.description: Kept separate rather than merged: the ATAS path records NativeSequenceAvailable=false while the direct path delivers the sequence on every event. Conflating them would misattribute a client limitation to the vendor.

mappedStreamTemplates.description: Measured, not documented: async_rithmic 1.6.3 maps exactly [150, 151, 156, 160, 161].

observedUnmappedTemplates.description: Templates seen on the wire with no message class. Observed: 152, 153, 154, 155, 157, 158, 162, 163.

dataQualityRole.description: ADR-001 and ADR-002. Only AUTHORITATIVE_CORE may gate a core analytic; RESEARCH_TELEMETRY never can (MRBS DQ-002).

then.description: NOT_EVIDENCED may never be paired with a core role - an unevidenced surface cannot be authoritative.
